recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿各階段嗜酸性球（含粗大橘紅色顆粒的前驅細胞），切片也見大量嗜酸性球浸潤，染色體圖顯示 t(8;9)(p11.2;q33.2)，涉及 FGFR1 所在的 8p11，符合伴 FGFR1 重排的骨髓性腫瘤。
features: Marked eosinophilia with mature eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors containing coarse orange-red and some immature dark-staining granules (panels A-B)
Admixed myeloid precursors, band/segmented neutrophils and monocytoid cells; eosinophil nuclei variably hypolobated
Several large immature cells with basophilic cytoplasm and granular inclusions in the aspirate smear
Bone marrow biopsy (panel C) hypercellular with sheets of eosinophils (bright eosinophilic cytoplasm) among myeloid cells
Partial karyotype (panel D) shows t(8;9)(p11.2;q33.2) with arrows at the breakpoints on chromosomes 8 and 9
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show a hypercellular myeloid population with marked eosinophilia, including numerous eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with coarse orange and admixed dark immature granules, together with neutrophilic precursors and occasional large immature cells. The trephine biopsy is hypercellular with abundant eosinophils. The partial karyotype demonstrates t(8;9)(p11.2;q33.2), placing a breakpoint at the FGFR1 locus (8p11.2). Findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and FGFR1 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophilia lacks a clonal cytogenetic abnormality and dysplastic immature eosinophil granules; an 8p11 rearrangement defines the neoplasm.

FIP1L1::PDGFRA is cryptic on karyotype and detected by FISH/RT-PCR (CHIC2 deletion) with mast cell increase and imatinib sensitivity, whereas FGFR1 cases show 8p11 translocations and are imatinib-resistant.
CEL requires clonality or increased blasts in the absence of PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2/FLT3/ETV6::ABL1 rearrangement.
AML with CBFB::MYH11 has increased blasts, monocytic differentiation and abnormal eosinophils with basophilic granules plus chromosome 16 abnormality rather than an 8p11 translocation.

captions: A-B: marrow aspirate smears with marked eosinophilia and eosinophil precursors; C: hypercellular marrow biopsy rich in eosinophils; D: partial karyotype showing t(8;9)(p11.2;q33.2)
